meta.title: Add column-aware scan feature
meta.body_summary: Add scan_data_with_columns method to Store trait with default impl, optimized Parquet projection, and integration tests; improves I/O efficiency by reading only requested columns.

perf_labels.notes: Codex adds scan_data_with_columns to Store trait and Parquet projection; PR is open with no reviews and no benchmark evidence, relying on narrative claims of I/O optimization.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 202 changed lines across 4 files, this is a small edit by absolute volume, introducing a new column-aware scan API with a default implementation and Parquet optimization. The PR is still open without review, so outcome (open) is consistent with pending evaluation.

review_details.performance_claim: Improve I/O efficiency by scanning only needed columns instead of full rows, particularly optimizing Parquet columnar reads.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Codex successfully added a new method to the Store trait with a default implementation and integrated with Parquet's column projection, demonstrating capability for moderate storage-layer API changes, but no review feedback yet to confirm functional correctness or performance gains.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No performance data or review text available; only the PR description mentions column-aware scanning benefits without numbers.

core_change_summary.description: Add scan_data_with_columns method signature to Store trait with a default implementation that calls scan_data, implement optimized projection in Parquet store by selecting only requested columns, and add integration tests for memory and Parquet backends.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Test files verify the new method behavior but do not add benchmark measurements.
